name: pebble-monorepo
description: Pebble — a local-first control center for AI coding agents.

scripts.build: pnpm -r --filter "./packages/core" --filter "./packages/server" --filter "./packages/cli" run build && pnpm --filter "./packages/web" run build
scripts.typecheck: tsc --build --force packages/core packages/server packages/cli && pnpm --filter "./packages/web" run typecheck
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build && pnpm run test
